title: Nostalgia
notes: Nearly every asset lives in MASS/*.dat archives ('SSAM': count, then offset/size/32-byte name entries from the end of the table), mostly LZ10. Maps (*.mmc) decompress to an offset table of parts, some nested, each part an 'NMDP' wrapper around a standard BMD0 or BTX0. nitro.files() unpacks all three; without them the ROM shows 1 texture.
71% of the BG tile keys (171k) are the painted world map in mass_navi_map.dat, which has almost no repeated tiles.

BG screens are 8bpp with palettes loaded into shared palette memory next to other colours, so the exact bg1 key (whole 256-colour palette) missed on 196/200 logged tiles whose tile hash was right. build stores tiles that occur in one image only under the '$' palette wildcard (183k of 240k files).
